title: Patrick Clancy Describes Grief in First Interview Since Mistrial
description: Mr. Clancy said in a ‘60 Minutes’ interview that he dreams “all the time” about his three children, who were strangled to death in 2023 by his former wife, Lindsay Clancy.
author: Maia Spoto and Jenna Russell

title: Trump Gets Caught in a Dilemma Over a Saudi Plea for Military Help
description: The president vacillated but decided on Sunday not to join Saudi Arabia, for now, in joint strikes against the Houthis in Yemen. But he also needs the kingdom’s cooperation in his war against Iran.
author: Helene Cooper, Eric Schmitt, Jonathan Swan and Maggie Haberman

title: ICE Agent Shoots Venezuelan Immigrant in Austin, Local Authorities Say
description: The shooting in the Texas capital is the latest by federal immigration agents as the Trump administration intensifies its deportation effort.
author: Christina Morales and Lauren McGaughy

title: Republican Who Runs South Dakota Elections Backs Democrat to Succeed Her
description: Monae Johnson, the secretary of state, is the latest Republican incumbent to speak out against conservative candidates as President Trump loses support before midterm elections.
author: Christina Morales

title: Abdul El-Sayed, a Democrat, Has an Unlikely Defender: Tucker Carlson
description: Mr. Carlson, the far-right podcaster, has promoted Abdul El-Sayed’s comments and sharply criticized his Republican rival in Michigan. Strategists are scratching their heads.
author: Tim Balk

title: Sikh Truck Drivers Worried Following Stabbing Attack at Rest Stop
description: A crackdown on immigrant commercial drivers and a DHS social media post targeting Sikh drivers preceded the attack, which has left the Sikh community deeply unsettled.
author: Miriam Jordan

title: Troy Jackson, a Progressive Brawler, Tries to Flip a Senate Seat in Maine
description: Mr. Jackson landed in the race unexpectedly. Democrats are hoping he can unseat Susan Collins, a Republican, in their bid to retake the Senate.
author: Beth Reinhard

title: American Yom Kippur: How Jews Across the U.S. Observe the Holiest Day of the Year
description: From 200-mile treks to synagogue to spiritual striving, readers share the rituals that define Judaism’s holiest day for them.
author: Yair Rosenberg

title: Trump Says His D.C. Arch Would Be a ‘Military Complex’ Housing Drones and Snipers
description: The president’s announcement on Sunday echoed his justification for the White House ballroom: that the project was necessary for national security.
author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs

title: How President Trump Broke the Kennedy Center
description: Internal emails and documents demonstrate the political capture of the institution, including how officials once pursued a plan to unload much of the art collection.
author: Elizabeth Williamson and Julia Jacobs

title: Pennsylvania Measles Outbreak Leads to an Increase in Vaccinations
description: As the outbreak grows to more than 700 confirmed cases, the largest in the country, some people remain opposed to vaccines and others are rushing to get the shots.
author: Pooja Salhotra, Mark Bonamo and Kevin Williams

title: Markwayne Mullin Lost His Pick to Lead ICE, as He Struggles to Prove His Toughness on Immigration
description: Markwayne Mullin is working to overcome hard-liners’ doubts about his leadership, his position undermined by missteps with the White House.
author: Hamed Aleaziz and Zolan Kanno-Youngs

title: In Maine, Swing Voters May Hold Key to Victory
description: Independent voters in Maine could decide the future of the Senate. We spoke with the voters in the swing county of Kennebec, which is critical to the election and possibly the control of Congress.
author: Ang Li, Caroline Kim, Luke Piotrowski and June Kim

title: Trump Faced Loss After Loss. He Then Turned to a Familiar Target: The Press.
description: The president’s ban of three media outlets from the White House fits a pattern of using the apparatus of government to crack down on his perceived enemies.
author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs

title: Hiker Dies After Lightning Strikes ‘Tin Shack’ on Utah Mountain
description: The 19-year-old man sought shelter with nine other people in a metal structure atop Mount Timpanogos on Friday, officials said.
author: Ishani Desai

title: A.I. Gone Rogue? Trump Proposes Not New Rules but an ‘A.I. Force.’
description: The president proposed a follow-up to his Space Force but continued to dismiss worries about A.I.’s pace or potential for harm.
author: David E. Sanger and Tim Balk

title: News Outlets Express Solidarity After Trump Bars Some Reporters
description: Some Democrats said President Trump’s ban was an attempt to control the press and distract voters as Republicans face deep challenges in the midterm elections.
author: Mack Liederman

title: Judy Gumbo, Who Found Freedom as a Yippie, Dies at 83
description: She was part of the leftist radical group, which mocked institutional authority with political satire and street theater.
author: Richard Sandomir

title: Newsom Signs Bills Meant to Prevent Trump’s Interference in Midterms
description: Gov. Gavin Newsom of California signed legislation that would make it illegal to interfere with ballots or election records in response to efforts by the president to restrict voting.
author: Laurel Rosenhall

title: Trump Says His Son Will Pay Back Russian Businessman for Wedding Party
description: The president said his eldest son, Donald Trump Jr., had decided to return the money, but defended the gift worth hundreds of thousands of dollars as “totally allowed.”
author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs
